description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources used in the AttrEval-Simulation, as referenced in the paper “Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models.” It is divided into six distinct segments, each representing a different dataset: ENTITYQUEST (blue, 26.0%), HOTPOTQA (red, 24.2%), POPQA (yellow, 21.6%), TRIVIAQA (orange, 22.7%), TREC (green, 1.9%), and WEBQUESTIO (teal, 3.6%). The segments are labeled with both the dataset name and its corresponding percentage, and lines connect each label to its respective slice. The chart visually emphasizes the relative contributions of each source, with ENTITYQUEST being the largest contributor and TREC the smallest. The data represents the combined training and simulation sets used for evaluating attribution in large language models.
